name: Our Deceased Loved Ones
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of death and the sorrow it brings, assuring believers that God is near to the brokenhearted and promises comfort to those who mourn (Psalms 34:18; Matthew 5:4). The death of the saints is precious in the sight of the Lord (Psalms 116:15), affirming His care over our deceased loved ones. At the same time, the Bible warns against seeking communication with the dead through familiar spirits or wizards, emphasizing reliance on God alone (Leviticus 19:31). Life and death occur within God’s sovereign timing, reminding us that there is a season for every purpose under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1).
